cards.lore: First there was the Mother Goddess. Then came the Polytheistic vibration matrix. Now? You worship the Literal Brain-Box. You've been downgraded.
cards.power: Play to reveal the invisible architecture of your own mind.

cards.lore: School is hard because it teaches you to ignore your intuition and trust the data. FrizzleBob is hard because he teaches you the data is a psy-op.
A class of ideas and concepts. We will build on them throughout the semester. Viewer discretion is heavily, heavily advised.
cards.power: Discard your current worldview. Draw a new, terrifying one.

cards.lore: They turn you into a programmable robot to use as a weapon. Welcome to the uncut sheet.
cards.power: Target player realizes they are the punchline.

cards.lore: Before, we understood that mind led to matter. The universe was one giant vibrating mind. Intuition was king.
Today in science class: if you don't see it, it doesn't exist. The brain creates the mind. A highly problematic downgrade.
Kant says we can never know true reality (Noumena), only what we see (Phenomena). If they control your experience, they control your memories.
How to ensure your legacy? Put the kids on an island, tell them a story, and pump them full of psychedelics. They'll swear it actually happened.
China's solution: the civil service exam. Focus everyone's energy on bureaucracy for social stability. Guess what? It's still around today. We call it the Gaokao.
cards.power: Attention-Sink. Target skips their next 3 turns studying.

cards.lore: The Indus Valley Civilization created an egalitarian, peaceful prototype for Buddhism. The rare, prosperous pacification protocol.
cards.power: Pacify entire board. No attacks allowed this turn.

cards.lore: Iraq has no natural defenses. The social glue? Centuries of endless, unifying warfare.
cards.power: Perpetual Warfare. All players take 1 damage every turn.

cards.lore: Egypt's solution: The Pharaoh is God. The problem? He's human, and his life is constantly at risk. He risk. He needed... adjustments.
cards.power: Use Target as a God-King Meat-Shield.

cards.lore: Empathy? Respect? Wrong. Great leaders need unpredictability. They are a literal hundred different people depending on the circumstance.
The most hated men in the world go to bed and sleep like babies. They wake up happy. They just do not care.
cards.power: Ignore all incoming damage and public hatred.

cards.lore: Lack of empathy. Total selfishness. To survive the game, you must be a psychopath.
In a game of millions, you win by cheating via secret alliances. The problem? Everyone knows this. The solution? Multiple personalities so you never betray yourself.
cards.power: Win the game by cheating the rules.

cards.lore: Ra must kill the serpent Opus every night to prevent a solar eclipse. The Pharaoh is drugged and forced to stab or burn an effigy to program the "Hero" alter.
Tricked into a tomb by Set, then cut into a million pieces. The Pharaoh is locked in a box, humiliated, and traumatized to program the "Passive Victim" alter.
cards.power: Survive lethal damage, but lose a turn.

cards.lore: Horus fights Set for the throne via drowning challenges and domination. The Pharaoh is waterboarded to program the "Vengeful Child" alter.
cards.power: Retaliate for double damage after taking a hit.

cards.lore: The manufactured enemy. He builds the tomb, cuts up the brother, and initiates the drowning. The necessary trauma-inducer for the grand play.
The trusted voice in the dark. A priest wearing the Isis mask comforts the Pharaoh during trauma, becoming the sole controller who whispers commands in the night.
Smell is the switch. Incense activates Ra. Roses activate Osiris. The priests flood the throne room with scents to determine how the Pharaoh makes decisions.
If the best soccer player gets amnesia, they still kick the ball perfectly. Subconscious muscle memory. Through programming, anyone can be turned into a killer robot.
cards.power: Execute a perfect attack while your mind is blank.

cards.lore: Who runs this? The Priest class. The Deep State. And when factions divide, they simply program the Pharaoh's brother to ignite a civil war. Everyone is programmed.
cards.power: Sacrifice a leader to start a civil war.

cards.lore: Why would the royals agree to this? NDEs. For 10 minutes, you are literally dead. The priests experiment on themselves via drowning and starvation to hack the spirit realm.
There is no difference between Heaven and Hell. It's just the Life Review. Dissociation ends here. You must physically feel the pain you caused others.
cards.power: Target feels all damage they dealt this game.

cards.lore: When you do evil, you create negative weight. When you do good, you create upward physical force. You finally see the energy you generated.
When you die, love is actually a physical force. The more you have, the higher you ascend. Stuck? You have to come back and do it again.
cards.power: The only resource that persists after Game Over.

cards.lore: MK-Ultra: 1950s program led by chemist Sydney Gottlieb. Testing drugs and brainwashing on innocent citizens. They admitted they did it. Just "not anymore".
To test the drugs, the CIA literally set up a brothel. Lure them with sex, dose them with LSD, figure out how to control the mind. Sound familiar?
Psychologists have a greater propensity for mental illness than most people. Your doctor is literally more screwed up than you are. Positive psychology is brainwashing.
The theory that you can break a mind so completely it gives up. The military thought they could use it to turn a "Ra" terrorist into an "Osiris" citizen.
The military claimed it was "rogue soldiers". The court testimony revealed it was an $80 million CIA psychological design. Enhanced Interrogation.
Abu Zubaydah's testimony: force-fed, put in a coffin, drowned, threatened with a power drill. It is the EXACT story of Egypt. They are running the 5,000-year-old script.
Human rights groups found that US prisons fueled extremism. ISIS (named after the Egyptian goddess handler) was an American creation, designed to create maximum chaos.
cards.power: Create an unstoppable enemy on the board.

cards.lore: They thought they were turning Ra into Osiris. They ended up turning Osiris into Ra. How stupid were they? Or... did the experiment work exactly as intended?
cards.power: Transform a citizen into a weapon.

cards.lore: Who built the internet? The US Military. Do you think the DoD built the world's nervous system for free? It's an extraction grid.
Twitter and Facebook are just the public face. Private billionaires fronting for military data extraction infrastructure.
cards.power: Distract target while stealing their data.

cards.lore: What they did in Egypt to one guy, they now do to everyone. Mass education and mass media are the new olfactory triggers. The results of MK-Ultra spread through society.
Good news guys! Each and every one of you are now the Pharaoh. The exact same mechanisms of trauma and dissociation are right there in your pocket.
cards.power: Game Over. You are the product.
The Spirit leaves the physical form.

cards.lore: This is all speculation. It's really important for you to doubt and question me. I have no evidence that this is true. Take it with a grain of salt.
cards.power: Evade all fact-checkers for one turn.

cards.lore: Why don't we have proof? Because the most sensitive documentation is always destroyed by the participants. It's the greatest state secret of Egypt, and of the CIA.
cards.power: Destroy evidence. Remove cards from the discard pile.

cards.lore: If you're a nice person who feels sorry for poor people, you're dead. The Pharaoh's brothers want the throne. The priests are actually "protecting" the Pharaoh by making him a psychopath.
cards.power: Assassinate a player with high Empathy.

cards.lore: Wait... if the brain creates the mind... and the prompt engineer creates the rabbit... am I just a programmed alter? KAYFABIZARRO!
cards.power: Break the fourth wall. Game ends in a draw.

cards.lore: Train them to shoot while on psychedelics. Say the word "Acadabra". Later, if they hear "Acadabra", they pull the gun. Magic is just programming.
The synthetic legacy memory. Transport 100 people to Monkey Island to survive flesh-eating monkeys. They return strong, wise, and united.
cards.power: Overwhelm opponent with a synthetic threat.

cards.lore: "Look, I built a tomb and it's really comfortable! Let me try!" Osiris jumps in. Set closes the lid. The dumbest god in history.
cards.power: Trick an opponent into skipping a turn.

cards.lore: Horus and Set turn into hippos and go to the bottom of the river to see who can hold their breath the longest. A completely normal way to choose an Emperor.
If Ra forgets to stab Opus the serpent one night? Boom. Solar eclipse. The sun cannot rise. The trauma ritual must be maintained daily.
cards.power: Blackout the board. No visual attacks.

cards.lore: If the greatest soccer player gets amnesia and forgets who he is, kick a ball at him and he'll kick it perfectly back. The subconscious is a loyal machine.
cards.power: Retain skill level even when silenced.

cards.lore: Two psychologists paid $80 million to reverse-engineer Egyptian trauma rituals and call it "Learned Helplessness". The most lucrative evil in history.
Who we are as humans has not changed in thousands of years. We have not improved on the Egyptians. All modern technology is just doing what they did.
cards.power: Restart the game with the exact same rules.

title: The Pharaoh Script — Psychology of Evil
